title: Express fast forward force against light external resistance.
brief: A lightly rear-resisted broad jump is the priority, keeping the natural arm drive while resisting forward body travel. A small dumbbell broad jump removes free arm swing and adds carried mass; grounded landmine extension and a kickstand swing emphasize rapid loaded leg/hip force with fewer impacts. Two different forward release paths complete the external-acceleration jobs.

explosive.name: Rear-band-Resisted Broad Jump
explosive.job: Apply forward body impulse against an opposing horizontal force while preserving arm coordination.
explosive.cue: Use a broad comfortable band low around the pelvis, secured behind by a qualified holder/verified anchor; dip and swing naturally into a short two-foot forward jump, then hold.
explosive.regress: Reduce tension and travel; stop if the band shifts, rebounds the athlete backward or destabilizes the landing.
explosive.intent: Light consistent resistance and short controlled projection

explosive.name: Dumbbell Broad Jump — Arms Fixed at Sides
explosive.job: Produce forward impulse with carried mass and no free arm swing.
explosive.cue: Hold very light dumbbells securely at the sides, dip once and make a short forward jump; keep arms quiet and land on two feet with a 2 s hold.
explosive.regress: Reduce load/travel; stop if grip, arm swinging or a heavy landing dominates.
explosive.intent: Very light load, fast push, modest distance

explosive.name: Landmine Power Squat — No Flight
explosive.job: Drive a lightly loaded angled implement rapidly through leg extension without another landing.
explosive.cue: Hold a light landmine end at chest level with both hands, use a shallow squat and stand rapidly to a tall finish while keeping feet in contact; no separate press. Lower/reset under control.
explosive.regress: Use less load/range; stop if the anchor moves or the athlete arches/pushes with the arms instead of extending the legs.
explosive.intent: Rapid extension against light resistance; feet remain planted
explosive.gate: Secure landmine pivot, suitable bar/handle and verified arc clearance.

explosive.name: Kickstand Dead-Stop Kettlebell Swing
explosive.job: Bias fast hip extension toward one lead leg while the rear foot supplies a stable small support.
explosive.cue: Use a short kickstand stance, park a light bell between reps; hike, snap the hips to float the bell below chest height, then park under control without twisting.
explosive.regress: Reduce load and narrow the rear offset; stop if pelvis rotation or arm lifting replaces hip drive.
explosive.intent: Crisp hip-driven acceleration; feet stay planted and the bell stays controlled
explosive.gate: Familiar kickstand hinge and bell handling.

explosive.name: Squat Medicine Ball Chest Throw
explosive.job: Accelerate a chest-held load forward through a coordinated bilateral leg drive.
explosive.cue: Hold a light ball at the chest, descend to a comfortable squat and extend promptly into a two-hand forward chest release, keeping feet planted and ribs controlled.
explosive.regress: Reduce ball load/depth; stop for an arm-only heave or lumbar arching.
explosive.intent: Fast release with a light ball; retain the prescribed grounded support

explosive.name: Half-Kneeling Forward Medicine Ball Scoop Toss
explosive.job: Use a split grounded hip base and long low-to-forward arm path to express projection.
explosive.cue: One knee down and opposite foot flat, ball low beside/in front of the lead thigh; extend the hip and scoop straight forward with two hands, without twisting or rising into a jump.
explosive.regress: Use a lighter ball and smaller hinge; stop for unstable knee/foot support or rotation.
explosive.intent: Fast release with a light ball; retain the prescribed grounded support

control.name: Pallof Press — Bilateral Athletic Stance
control.job: Lightly resist trunk rotation so external force remains aligned with the forward push.
control.cue: With a light band pulling from one side, feet parallel and knees soft, press both hands forward, hold 2 s and return without turning; repeat facing the opposite pull direction.
control.regress: Use less band tension/shorter reach; stop for twisting or breath-holding.
control.intent: Bodyweight/light resistance, easy control; at least 5 clean reps in reserve or comparable ease

control.name: Glute Bridge March
control.job: Keep the pelvis steady while support alternates under a braced hip position.
control.cue: From a low short-lever bridge, lift and replace one foot at a time, alternating for eight total marches (four per side) without pelvic roll.
control.regress: Use smaller foot lifts/lower hip height; stop for cramp or trunk arching.
control.intent: Bodyweight/light resistance, easy control; at least 5 clean reps in reserve or comparable ease

strength.name: Hip Thrust — pelvic dumbbell, upper back on bench
Standing Calf Raise — hand-supported single-leg, dumbbell

decision: Resistance is kept light; only eight loaded/resisted jump landings are prescribed. Rearward elastic opposition, carried mass with fixed arms, and an anchored no-flight squat change force application/support rather than merely changing a weight number on an old drill. Kickstand swings change which leg carries the hip demand; all other work remains grounded or a throw. No heavier resistance, longer jump or added working set is earned by reaching Class 11. Strength doses stay modest with technical reserve.
next_job: Class 12 integrates a modest stationary hop–step–jump sequence with precise receiving and entry constraints; review actual linked-contact competence and recovery before delivery. The full sequence is now audited.
